hypothesis.hypothesis: LP2/57 identity and LP2/56 prime-minus-one with the documented skip reproduce the pinned references; a blind bounded search recovers synthetic prime-stream keys.
hypothesis.success: Both LP references exact at every rune, lossless inverse, and all 3 synthetic trials recover full rune sequence plus key; read guard probe passes; each search covers 928 candidates
hypothesis.failure: Completed exhaustive synthetic search selects a wrong answer or key: negative for this benchmark only; LP mismatch: regression failure
hypothesis.error_timeout_policy: Runtime exception is error; subprocess deadline is timeout; neither is a cryptanalytic negative
hypothesis.coverage_limit: Only two known pages and a no-skip synthetic subfamily; no unsolved page search and no proof of general language scoring reliability

additional_hypotheses.hypothesis: LP1 offers documented mechanisms and text associations that can be represented as evidence-typed links; A WARNING reproduces with 28-index and the LP1/05 matrix values follow GP sums of the actual runes.

parameters.matrix_transform: sum GP prime values of raw rune cell; preserve decimal cells

additional_hypotheses.scorer: none; exact rune references and exact integer table only
additional_hypotheses.success: A WARNING source rune sequences agree, exact independent expected sequence and inverse pass; all 25 matrix cells equal the pinned reference; graph evidence locators resolve and speculative links are not promoted to verified mechanism.
additional_hypotheses.failure: Completed comparison mismatch is negative for the specified source/transform, not for all LP1 theories; graph invalidity is an error.
additional_hypotheses.limits: No author-intent identification, no Vigenere solve in this round, no large key search, no assertion that an English word uniquely determines runes, no statistical prime-sum significance claim.
additional_hypotheses.next_step: Turn selected graph edges into preregistered, discriminating experiments; prioritize F-skip semantics and exact CIRCUMFERENCE key representation.

additional_hypotheses.hypothesis: FEED-002 representation claims can be separated into exact algebraic facts, source-specific structure and untested cryptographic interpretations.

parameters.field: all 29 residues; enumerate y=0..28 for each x=0..28
parameters.matrix: LP1/05 only, all eight square symmetries, compare all 25 positions
parameters.prime_mapping: all 29 GP entries, compare full values versus residues modulo 29
parameters.lp2_control: LP2/56 only; original offset=0 shift=1 skip=56 held fixed; compare position-stream phi(prime) with phi(GP[cipher_index])

additional_hypotheses.scorer: none; exact finite arithmetic and rune-reference equality
additional_hypotheses.success: All nonzero field residues have one inverse and zero has none; original matrix is centrosymmetric; the existing position stream agrees with independently counted totients; rune-value-based alternative has at least one exact-reference mismatch.
additional_hypotheses.failure: A completed alternative mismatch is a negative only for the listed page/parameters. A failed expected arithmetic check is recorded as a negative audit; exceptions/timeouts are separate execution statuses.
additional_hypotheses.limits: Finite-field availability is not evidence of multiplication in LP; mapped symmetries are not independent observations; no p-values, no author-intent inference, no corpus scan.
additional_hypotheses.next_step: Before any unsolved-page survey, freeze page/transcription versions, symmetry/statistic definitions, transformation deduplication, null controls and multiple-testing criteria.
